name: Sarita Naik

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sarita Naik writes poetry in English, Odia and Hindi. Kabita Live’s contributor biography places her writing alongside interests in dance and music. Her academic connection with Pipli College, Puri, is corroborated by the college’s English department, which lists her as a lecturer with an MPhil and a gold-medal distinction.

In “Being in Love”, affection changes the speaker’s experience of the everyday. An absent companion seems to walk nearby; words grow gentler, colours and flavours become more vivid, and even a crow’s call offers pleasure. The poem’s movement from distance to renewed attention gives love a transforming force, measured through the senses rather than through a grand outward event.
